reason: PURE. First thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR, and "no magnesium oxide" on the bisglycinate; that form is the gentle one on my stomach, so I'd try one box. I would skip the Complex because it has citrate, and citrate is what gave me cramps.
objection: No reviews yet, so I only have their word that it sits well in the stomach. I've already tried three brands this year and don't want a fourth dud.
would_change_my_mind: A few real verified reviews from people with sensitive stomachs, or the QR report actually opening a real batch result when I scan it.
